lighting_shading.note: Soft, diffuse lighting creates a gentle, toy-like appearance.

value_contrast.note: Mid-key values with good separation from the green background.

color_palette.note: Vibrant warm corals pop against the cool green background.

composition_hierarchy.note: Central placement with a clear vertical hierarchy of coral sizes.

shape_proportions.note: Chunky, rounded forms create a highly readable and friendly silhouette.

viewpoint_depth.note: Slightly elevated three-quarter view shows depth between coral layers.

edges_linework.note: Clean, unlined edges defined by color and shading.

surface_finish.note: Matte, clay-like finish with subtle speckling on coral tips.

rhythm_staging.note: Static arrangement with strong repetition of branching coral shapes.
